_readme: Per-run monitoring log, one file per calendar day (America/Phoenix), used to generate the Daily PDF Report. Distinct from cases.json, which is the permanent case/review-queue index.
_run_note:
Thirty-second scheduled run. 16 of 20 URLs served -- full coverage restored -- and 10,074 product pages reviewed, the highest to date and the first time past ten thousand.

YOUR ROSES RECOVERED ON ITS OWN, one run after its WordPress layer served an installation wizard in place of every data endpoint. Nothing was done differently: the same request was made and it answered. 1,730 products, up from the 1,720 last read on 2026-10-23. All 74 of its cases re-verified present, so the gap cost one day of verification and no evidence. This is the second time this site has gone dark and come back unaided -- the first was the 403 block of 2026-09-18 to 09-25 -- and the precedent holds both times: keep attempting, report it as a gap, hold the dates, change nothing.

One new case: YOURROSES-075, "Lady Ella Rose Plant|伊艾夫人" matching Lady Ella (Pending, App. Ser. No. 50051990, Jan Spek Rozen), classified Strong because the chart entry is a two-word phrase carried whole in the title. Captured the same morning.

Six listings remain removed, each re-confirmed by HTTP 404: MYROSEWORL-001..003, KATEROSES-001 and -002, HILLSIDERO-004. HILLSIDERO-005 is still present after returning yesterday. 378 of 384 cases re-verified; nothing left unchecked.

Redland Ranch Roses grew 1,887 -> 1,943, and 1,855 -> 1,943 over three runs, without any addition matching a chart name.

sites.notes: Facebook page; facebook.com is blocked by this environment's network egress policy at the CONNECT stage, so the page was never reached. No open product feed exists for a Facebook page in any case.
Etsy storefront; etsy.com is blocked by this environment's network egress policy at the CONNECT stage. The seller's own site (ergongzy.com) was crawled in full and carries the same catalog.
Served at 216 products, unchanged. MYROSEWORL-001..003 remain removed (HTTP 404).
Etsy shop closed (dormant). Roster entry retained per user instruction (2026-09-15); expected to stay inaccessible and not awaiting any decision.
Served at 174 products, unchanged. HILLSIDERO-005 still present; -004 still removed (HTTP 404).
Etsy storefront; etsy.com is blocked by this environment's network egress policy at the CONNECT stage.

Reached on the apex host after the www host was refused by the egress proxy. The Shopify feed returned HTTP 200 with an empty product array -- the store genuinely lists no products. Counted as checked, zero products.
Served at 62 products, unchanged. KATEROSES-001 and -002 remain removed (HTTP 404).
Served at 1,943 products, up 56 from 2026-10-26 and 88 over three runs. None of the additions matched a chart name.

Recovered on its own. The WordPress layer that served an installation wizard on 2026-10-26 is working again: 1,730 products through the product REST API, up from the 1,720 last read on 2026-10-23. Nothing was done differently -- the same request was made and it answered. All 74 of this site's cases re-verified present, and one new listing became YOURROSES-075.

screenshot_limitation: 332 of 384 cases carry a screenshot, including YOURROSES-075 captured today. The 52 without one each record why: High Garden 46 (7 Registered) -- the seller's pages blank themselves on detecting an automated browser, so these need manual capture and the measure was not bypassed; One Love 3 -- a membership login wall, also not bypassed; Flower Meadow Dream 3 -- listings removed, HTTP 404.
